title: Effect of prevalent polychlorinated biphenyls (PCBs) food contaminant on the MCF7, LNCap and MDA-MB-231 cell lines viability and PON1 gene expression level: proposed model of binding.
authors: Yazdi, Fatemeh; Shoeibi, Shahram; Yazdi, Mohammad Hossein; Eidi, Akram
journal: Daru : journal of Faculty of Pharmacy, Tehran University of Medical Sciences
one_liner_zh: 该文研究食品污染物PCBs对细胞活力和PON1基因表达的影响，并用分子对接预测其与AhR受体的结合，但核心是毒理学而非TF-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法创新。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Polychlorinated biphenyls (PCBs) are a group of synthetic organic chlorine compounds known as an organic pollutant in food sources, which play important roles in malignancies. The present study aimed to investigate the direct effects of prevalent PCBs in food in hormone-responsive and non-responsive cell lines. METHODS: In the current study, MCF-7, LNCap, and MDA-MB231 cell lines were treated with serial concentrations (0.001-100 muM) of PCBs for 48 h and cell viability assessment was performed using MTT assay. The best concentration then applied and the expression level of PON1 was evaluated using real-time PCR. Besides, molecular docking was performed to determine the binding mechanism and predicted binding energies of PBCs compounds to the AhR receptor. RESULTS: Unlike MCF-7 and LNCap cells, the viability of MDA-MB231 cells did not significantly change by different concentrations of PCBs. Meanwhile, quantitative gene expression analysis showed that the PON1 was significantly more expressed in MCF-7 and LNCap lines treated with PCB28 and PCB101. However, the expression level of this gene in other groups and also MDA-MB231cells did not demonstrate any significantly change. Also, the results of molecular docking showed that PBCs had steric interaction with AhR receptor. CONCLUSIONS: Current results showed that despite of hormone non-responsive cells the PCBs have a significant positive effect on hormone-responsive cell. Therefore, and regarding to the existence of PCBs contamination in food there should be serious concern about their impact on the prevalence of different malignancies which certainly should result in a standard limit for this material. abstract_zh: 背景：多氯联苯（PCBs）是一类合成有机氯化合物，作为食物来源中的有机污染物，在恶性肿瘤中发挥重要作用。本研究旨在探讨食物中常见的PCBs对激素反应性和非反应性细胞系的直接影响。方法：在本研究中，用系列浓度（0.001-100 μM）的PCBs处理MCF-7、LNCap和MDA-MB231细胞系48小时，并通过MTT法评估细胞活力。随后应用最佳浓度，并使用实时PCR评估PON1的表达水平。此外，进行分子对接以确定PCBs化合物与AhR受体的结合机制及预测结合能。结果：与MCF-7和LNCap细胞不同，不同浓度的PCBs对MDA-MB231细胞的活力无显著影响。同时，定量基因表达分析显示，在经PCB28和PCB101处理的MCF-7和LNCap细胞系中，PON1的表达显著升高。然而，该基因在其他组以及MDA-MB231细胞中的表达水平未显示任何显著变化。此外，分子对接结果表明，PCBs与AhR受体存在空间相互作用。结论：当前结果表明，尽管对激素非反应性细胞无显著影响，PCBs对激素反应性细胞具有显著的正向效应。因此，鉴于食物中PCBs污染的存在，应严肃关注其对不同恶性肿瘤患病率的影响，这必然应导致对此类物质设定标准限值。本研究旨在探讨食物中常见PCBs对激素反应性和非反应性细胞系的直接影响。用系列浓度的PCBs处理细胞系，并通过MTT法评估细胞活力。使用实时PCR评估PON1的表达水平。进行分子对接以确定PCBs化合物与AhR受体的结合机制及预测结合能。食物中PCBs污染的存在应引起对其对不同恶性肿瘤患病率影响的严肃关注，这必然应导致对此类物质设定标准限值。
